priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: Calling the disposer returned by `attach` no longer unregisters `handler`. Later messages can invoke callbacks after teardown, while repeated attachments retain handlers and duplicate processing.

findings.title: [P1] Restore polling cancellation in the returned disposer
findings.body: `startPolling` now discards the interval handle and returns a no-op disposer. Refreshes continue after cleanup, repeated mounts accumulate polling work, and the live interval can prevent Node.js processes from exiting.
